digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate: necessity probe + bug review tier
propositions: FixedBench shows 35-65% over-action (proposing changes without demonstrating necessity), but the plan-review gate has no criterion to detect this gap
Bug tickets currently short-circuit to bare exempt-PASS with zero LLM calls and findings, receiving no substantive review
Introduce a pass-1 advisory criterion 'necessity' that flags plans which do not motivate or reproduce the need for the proposed change
Implement a lightweight bug review tier that runs the DET floor and necessity probe for bugs as advisory (never blocking), replacing the current exempt-PASS
Both pieces must be registered non-orphan in criteria_routing.json and registry.py with default_posture advisory and no bug suppression for necessity
Post-ship effectiveness is auto-monitored via the standing recorder; advisory-to-blocking promotion is gated on effectiveness metrics, not a config flag
